Class Block

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.widgets.block.Block
All Implemented Interfaces:
Widget
public final class Block extends Object implements Widget
A block is a container widget with optional borders and titles.

Supports style-aware properties: border-type, border-color, background, and color.

  • Field Details

    • BORDER_TYPE

      public static final PropertyDefinition<BorderType> BORDER_TYPE
      The border-type property for border style. This property is inheritable - nested panels inherit border type. Default: BorderType.PLAIN

    • BORDER_COLOR

      public static final PropertyDefinition<Color> BORDER_COLOR
      The border-color property. This property is NOT inheritable.

    • BORDER_CHARS

      public static final PropertyDefinition<String> BORDER_CHARS
      The border-chars property for custom border character sets. Format: 8 quoted strings (top-h, bottom-h, left-v, right-v, tl, tr, bl, br). This property is NOT inheritable.

      public int verticalChrome()
      Returns the number of rows this block reserves for chrome (top and bottom borders, top and bottom titles, and vertical padding). The inner content area of any rendered block is area.height() minus this value (clamped at 0).
      Returns:
      rows of vertical chrome

    • horizontalChrome

      public int horizontalChrome()
